children: Switzerland experience marketing firm's H1 operating income rose 12% yr/yr to CHF 248.8 mln
EBITDA for H1 increased to CHF 34.3 mln from CHF 18.9 mln a year earlier
Company says growth driven by new events and improved operational efficiency
Company expects Middle East activities to return to normal in Q4, focused on local audiences
MCH Group continues to expand into new formats, including a stake in Jupiter Festival Miami
Company sees broader art market recovering after two subdued years
NEW EVENT LAUNCHES - Co said launch of Art Basel Qatar and delivery of major events including CONEXPO and Swissbau drove revenue growth
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY - Co said improved operational efficiency and disciplined execution supported profitability
EVENT TIMING - Co said more favourable timing of CES contributed positively to results
Sept 16 - UBS capital rules face further Swiss parliamentary hurdle
